# Current work: Could #2 Relic Forge (feature branch only)

Only `feature/raid-relic-coulds` is being authored. **Main0723, canonical00003/sourcefd05 and Shoulds tag00004/source0723 remain frozen**; Could #1 and #2 are not merged/deployed. Parent verified Could #1 **274/274 + actual recap SVG/1200×630 PNG downloads PASS**, reviewed canonical moon parity and visible Simulator watermarks, and pushed `c63ec31`. [Shared-state tagged-preview precautions](docs/TAGGED_PREVIEW.md) remain binding. No fade or resonance is included.

Open **/forge** from Atlas for **template design previews, not live customization**. Read-only `POST /api/forge` accepts exactly `{description}` in an application/json body≤1024bytes. Descriptions are plain, NFKC/casefolded,≤240 Unicode characters before/after normalization; duplicate/escaped duplicate/unknown/prototype keys, invalid UTF8 and malformed requests fail. The public request budget applies before work. Templates do no DB reads/writes or provider calls; no description/prompt is persisted, logged, cached, put in URLs/history or uploaded to a provider. Keyword choices are deterministic (crystal/orb/seed; tall/broad; warm/violet) with a fixed fallback. The app necessarily receives the transient POST body.

The design object uses strict **schema v1**: exactly version1, shape enum, facets integer3–12, finite aspect0.6–1.6 and exactly four lowercase six-hex colors. JSON exports wrap that object with schemaVersion/source/mode/applied:false. Rendering uses only own fixed SVG nodes and validated color/number attributes: no submitted SVG/path/CSS/URLs or user text interpolation. Public preview, JSON copy/download and optional SVG download use textContent/blob URLs with cleanup and clear/error states;375px/keyboard support is included. No design automatically changes the live relic, overlay, holder, handoff or lineage count. Existing canonical rune byte goldens are unchanged.

Optional model generation is a separate **authenticated recipient-owner** page at `/control/<configuredKeeperId>/forge`, linked from private controls. It uses exact Origin, role-scoped cookie, expiry/CSRF and a new narrow≤1024byte JSON POST with exactly csrf/description/acknowledge:boolean. Existing control actions still require exactly action+csrf. The UI explains provider upload/possible charges and requires explicit acknowledgement before a paid click; it disables the model button while off. Public `/forge` works without auth, a completed stop or a key and cannot request model generation via extra fields or query.

**Both existing Chronicle gates stay OFF**, no key provisioned. Paid Forge would need separate prior owner approval, `CHRONICLE_ENABLED=true`, `CHRONICLE_ALLOW_PAID=true` and an owner-bound `OPENAI_API_KEY` Secret Manager reference—never a key value in source/browser/logs. Small models can incur charges; no price is asserted. The fixed model is `gpt-4.1-mini`, max256 output tokens, native fixed-endpoint bounded transport (8s/16KiB per response), no retries. Free `omni-moderation-latest` input moderation precedes any paid request; validated strict schema output is moderated again before acceptance. Flags/malformed/unavailable/unsupported output/429/timeouts fall back to a safe template.

Only the explicitly submitted normalized description, schema and fixed instructions go upstream: no chat/mark text, account IDs, associations or app tokens. Future owners must avoid personal data in descriptions. One persisted **separate Forge attempt per latest completed received stop** is claimed transactionally before upstream calls; failures/crashes remain consumed. Off/no-key/no-ack performs zero calls/claims. Wrong recipient/no completed stop fails before provider work. Finish rereads fresh lineage and merges only the validated Forge field under the512KiB guard, preserving concurrent forgetting. No raw description or prompt is stored. This is mocked integration only; no provider/docs requests or live efficacy/availability proof.

The local judges wrapper adds Forge links, immediate Simulator labels and mode-stamped JSON/SVG exports; it cannot inherit paid provider configuration. Try “tall violet crystal with 8 facets” then “warm amber orb”. The new optional host gate `node scripts/browser-smoke-forge.js` tests deterministic templates,375px/error states and actual JSON/SVG downloads using a unique owned `~/Downloads/raid-relic-forge-*` directory, sandboxed Chromium, blocked nonlocal requests and exact cleanup after browser close. Existing four browser scripts are unchanged and await parent rerun alongside this gate. No new Forge browser/download proof is claimed yet.

OAuth scopes remain exactly Keeper `channel:bot channel:manage:raids`; bot `user:read:chat user:write:chat user:bot`. No dependencies, env gates, live/cloud/build/deploy/provider/credential actions or commits were added. Older Could #1/Shoulds notes below retain historical QA; current freezes and scope above supersede them.
